thread:
maria: quick design check — thinking out loud about a lighter, self-contained "signed-lease" we can hand to runtimes to avoid credential rebinds when requests cross hosted/dedicated/private boundaries. intent: no outbound callback required for validation (important for air-gapped/private).
aj: quick q — how is this different from existing probe tokens? we already issue ephemeral probes.
kevin: current probes are ephemeral but require the control plane to be in the loop for rebind/refresh. signed-lease is self-contained: runtime verifies signature + expiry locally, so private deployments don't need outbound network to validate.
sara: main concern is revocation — if a lease is compromised we need a way to revoke quickly. do we rely on TTL only?
maria: options i sketched: 1) very short TTL (30s) + accept brief increased rebinds, 2) signed lease with revocation list pushed via config-sync (works for private), 3) hybrid: signed lease + lease_id that control plane can mark as revoked and runtime consults revocation cache (best-effort).
aj: short TTL works but might blow up rps on control plane for high-throughput customers. maybe "renewable lease" where runtime can ask to refresh but fallback to no-refresh mode if unreachable.
kevin: also need strong audit metadata in the lease so console can explain routing choices. include origin, route_policy, project_id, model_version, maybe sampling of prompt hash for privacy.
maria: example payload i was thinking (YAML-ish for clarity):
```yaml
lease_id: "l-abc123"
issued_by: "controlplane-1"
project: "search"
model: "redwood-3b"
actions: ["infer"]
iat: 1680000000
exp: 1680000030
route_hint: "dedicated-pool-a"
sig: "<base64>"
```
sara: implementation note — runtime verifies sig using pinned controlplane pubkey from deploy manifest/config. private installs rotate via KMS; we need a documented key-rotation/rollout path.
aj: ops-bot: for rollout checklist, please.
ops-bot: - add lease verifier library to runtimes
- add control plane signing endpoint + signing key mgmt
- add config-sync channel for pubkey + revocation cache
- add console audit mapping lease_id -> routing decisions
kevin: backward compat: runtimes should accept both old probe tokens and new signed leases while feature-flag rolling.
maria: i'll draft a short RFC capturing tradeoffs: revocation strategies (ttl vs revocation list), perf impact, observability fields, key rotation, and fallback behavior when runtime sees expired/unverifiable lease. will call out private-specific constraints (no outbound).
sara: +1, small naming nit: call it "signed-lease" (not "probe-lease") to avoid confusion with the existing probe flow.
aj: :thumbsup:
kevin: pinging @infra for perf estimates on TTL-based approach — we need numbers to choose TTL defaults.
maria: thanks all — i'll drop a draft in #rfc when ready and include example verifier snippets.
